title: Remove login button and replace smmourprice logo with IBAZEX logo

requirements.text: Remove the login button from the Header component across all pages
acceptanceCriteria: Login button is no longer visible in the Header component
No authentication UI elements remain in the header
Navigation remains functional without login functionality

requirements.text: Remove the smmourprice logo from all components where it appears
acceptanceCriteria: All references to smmourprice logo are removed from the codebase

requirements.text: Add IBAZEX logo in place of the removed smmourprice logo in Header, Hero, and Footer components
acceptanceCriteria: IBAZEX logo displays in the Header component
IBAZEX logo displays in the Hero section
IBAZEX logo displays in the Footer component
Logo styling is consistent with the existing design

constraints: Do not modify backend authentication logic
nonGoals: Removing Internet Identity integration from the backend

required: IBAZEX brand logo with modern design suitable for header navigation (ibazex-logo.dim_200x60.png)
IBAZEX brand logo larger version for hero section with transparent background (ibazex-logo-hero.dim_400x120.png)
